item.title: Against "Illegal Acquisition of Recordings," Han Dong-hoon Says "I Will Protect the Whistleblower" (與 “녹취록 불법 입수” 한동훈 “제보자 지킬 것”)
item.description:
As independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon continues to disclose recorded conversations and other materials regarding suspicions of "COVID-19 drug lobbying" involving Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, the Democratic Party of Korea raised the possibility of an illegal leak of prosecution investigation materials on the 9th. At the party's Supreme Council meeting that day, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok stated, "The various claims raised by lawmaker Han could not have emerged without a collaborator within the prosecution." (무소속 한동훈 의원이 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자의 ‘코로나 신약 로비’ 의혹과 관련해 연일 녹취록 등을 폭로하는 가운데, 더불어민주당은 9일 검찰 수사 자료 불법 유출 가능성을 제기했다. 민주당 김민석 대표는 이날 최고위원 회의에서 “한 의원이 제기하는 여러 주장은 검찰 내에 협력자가 없으면 발생할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Since the 2nd, lawmaker Han has been releasing content of conversations between a female broker surnamed Yang and figures such as Kim, the nominee, and Kang, a founder of Genencell. The ruling camp suggests that Han may have been briefed on such materials during his tenure as Minister of Justice, or received them from the prosecution investigation team after leaving office. The Seoul Western District Prosecutors' Office investigation into the COVID-19 drug lobbying suspicions ran from November 2022 to December 2024, partially overlapping with Han's term as Minister of Justice (May 2022–December 2023). (한 의원은 지난 2일부터 연일 여성 브로커 양모씨가 김 후보자나 제넨셀 창업자 강모씨 등과 대화한 내용을 공개해왔다. 여권에선 한 의원이 법무부 장관 시절 이런 자료들을 보고받았거나, 퇴임 후 검찰 수사팀에서 넘겨받았을 가능성을 제기한다. 서울서부지검의 코로나 신약 로비 의혹 수사는 2022년 11월~2024년 12월 진행돼, 한 의원의 법무부 장관 재임 시기(2022년 5월~2023년 12월)와 일부 겹친다.)

At the National Assembly's government question session that day, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Hae-sik called for "a full audit of access logs to the Ministry of Justice and prosecution systems." Prime Minister Han Duck-soo responded, "If non-public investigation materials were leaked externally without going through proper procedures, this is a very serious matter," adding, "I will instruct a thorough review of the legality and the facts." Lee Jin-soo, acting Minister of Justice, stated that documents such as the "indictment plan" disclosed by lawmaker Han should not have been leaked and fall under the scope of investigation. After related questioning, Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-gyo shouted from her seat, "He should be arrested. He should be urgently arrested," drawing applause only from Democratic Party members. (이날 국회 대정부 질문에서 민주당 이해식 의원은 “법무부와 검찰의 시스템 접속 기록 등을 전면 감사해야 한다”고 했다. 한성숙 총리는 “비공개 수사 자료가 적법한 절차를 거치지 않고 외부로 유출됐다면 매우 엄중한 사안”이라며 “위법 여부, 사실관계를 면밀히 확인하도록 지시하겠다”고 했다. 이진수 법무부 장관 직무대행은 한 의원이 공개했던 ‘검찰 기소 계획서’ 등이 유출돼서는 안 되는 것이라며 수사 대상에 해당한다고 밝혔다. 관련 질의 후 서영교 민주당 의원은 의석에서 “체포해야 돼. 긴급 체포해야 해”라고 외쳤고, 민주당 의원들만 박수를 쳤다.)

Lawmaker Han stated that he received the materials from a "public interest whistleblower" and that he is committed to "protecting the whistleblower with his life." That day, Han said, "I can state categorically that I have received no cooperation or materials from the prosecution." He then raised further suspicions, asking, "Did the nominee Kim actually visit the broker Yang's home?" (한 의원은 해당 자료를 ‘공익제보자’에게 받았으며, “공익제보자를 목숨 걸고 지키겠다”는 입장이다. 한 의원은 이날 “단언컨대 검찰로부터 어떤 협력이나 자료를 받은 사실이 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 “김 후보자는 양 브로커 자택에 간 사실이 있느냐”며 추가 의혹을 제기했다.)

item.title: Genencell Whistleblower Even Received Death Threats (제넨셀 공익신고자, 살해 협박까지 받았다)
item.description:
The emergence of the corruption scandal involving a COVID-19 drug and lobbying tied to Minister of Justice nominee Kim Seung-won was significantly aided by a tip from whistleblower A. In October 2021, A, who worked as an accounting consultant at broker Yang's company, claimed to have witnessed the entire process of Yang using Kim to petition the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. A reported the matter to investigative authorities in November 2022 and was granted whistleblower status by the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission. (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 관련된 코로나 신약 로비 의혹이 수면 위로 드러난 데는 공익신고자 A씨의 제보가 중요한 단서가 됐다. 2021년 10월 브로커 양모씨의 회사에서 회계 담당 컨설턴트로 일했던 A씨는 양씨가 김 후보자를 통해 식품의약품안전처에 청탁하는 과정 전반을 목격했다고 한다. A씨는 2022년 11월 수사기관에 관련 사실을 제보해 국민권익위원회부터 공익신고자 지위를 얻었다.)

According to a statement A submitted to investigators, Kang, the founder of the pharmaceutical company Genencell, promised broker Yang a "big one" (1 billion won) as a success fee for lobbying the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for clinical trial approval. In a phone call with A, Yang said, "I talked to my oppa Seung-won (candidate Kim) and arranged for direct communication with the Minister of Food and Drug Safety," adding, "(But Kang) changed the planned 1 billion won investment to 600 million won, which is frustrating." (A씨가 수사기관에 제출한 의견서에 따르면, 제약사 제넨셀 설립자 강모씨는 브로커 양씨에게 식약처 임상시험 로비 성공 보수로 ‘큰 거 한 장’(10억원)을 약속했다. 양씨는 A씨와의 통화에서 “내가 승원 오빠(김 후보자)에게 얘기해서 식약처장과 직접 소통하게 했던 것”이라며 “(그런데 강씨가) 10억원 투자하기로 한 것을 6억원으로 바꿔 짜증 난다”고 했다.)

After the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety approved the clinical trial and Genencell founder Kang sought to invest in Yang's company, there was internal opposition at Genencell, citing "no justification for the investment." A said he was involved in creating that "justification" for Yang. A handled the planning of a fake corporate presentation for Yang's company and the practical work of developing an internet platform. According to A, Yang told him, "If the business succeeds, I'll make sure you have 2 billion won within three years," but even after securing the investment, Yang did not pay the consulting fees. A claims that Yang squandered the investment funds on cryptocurrency and even filed for planned bankruptcy to evade debts. (식약처 임상시험 승인이 나고 제넨셀 창업주 강씨가 양씨 회사에 투자하려 하자 제넨셀 내부에서도 “투자할 명분이 없다”며 반대가 있었다. A씨는 양씨를 위해 ‘명분’을 만드는 작업에 관여했다고 한다. 양씨 회사의 허위 기업 설명회 기획, 인터넷 플랫폼 구축 개발 실무를 A씨가 맡았다. A씨에 따르면 양씨는 A씨에게 “사업만 성공하면 3년 내에 20억원을 가질 수 있게 해주겠다”고 했지만 투자 유치 이후에도 용역 비용을 지불하지 않았다. 양씨가 투자금을 가상화폐 투자에 탕진하고, 채무를 회피하려 기획 파산까지 신청했다는 것이 A씨 주장이다.)

As the investigation intensified in the second half of 2023, A received police protection at the investigative team's recommendation. There were indications that broker Yang had told those around him, "I'll kill A without a trace." The second trial is currently underway regarding embezzlement charges against Genencell founder Kang, while the first trial is ongoing concerning charges of promising bribes between Kang and broker Yang. (2023년 하반기 수사가 본격화되자 A씨는 수사팀 권유로 경찰의 신변 보호를 받기도 했다. 브로커 양씨가 주위에 “A씨를 쥐도 새도 모르게 죽여버리겠다”고 말했다는 정황이 있었다는 것이다. 제넨셀 창업주 강씨의 배임 혐의 등에 대해선 현재 2심이, 강씨와 브로커 양씨의 뇌물 공여 약속 혐의에 대해선 1심이 진행 중이다.)

With the recent nomination of Kim Seung-won bringing the lobbying case back into the spotlight, A says he is once again facing threats. In a phone call with this newspaper, A stated, "These days, calls come in from unknown numbers, and quite a few people say, 'Watch your mouth or I'll kill you,' then hang up." In response, A has again requested protection from the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission but has only received the reply that "procedures are underway," with no protective measures taken so far. A said, "I understand candidate Kim previously proposed an amendment to the Whistleblower Protection Act for the sake of whistleblowers, but now I'm the one suffering harm." (최근 김승원 후보자 지명으로 로비 사건이 수면 위로 다시 떠오르자 A씨는 다시 협박에 시달리고 있다고 한다. A씨는 본지 통화에서 “요즘 모르는 번호로 전화가 걸려와 ‘입조심하지 않으면 죽여 버리겠다’면서 끊어버리는 사람이 적지 않다”고 했다. 이에 A씨는 권익위에 재차 신변 보호 요청을 했지만 “절차가 진행 중”이라는 답변만 들었고, 아직 보호 조치는 이뤄지지 않았다고 한다. A씨는 “김 후보자는 공익신고자를 위해 공익신고자 보호법 개정안까지 발의했던 분으로 아는데, 지금은 제가 피해를 보고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "My Term Is Clearly Limited Under the Constitution" (李 “헌법상 제 임기는 명확히 제한돼 있어”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to France, said on the 9th (local time), "My term is clearly limited under the Constitution." The President made these remarks while explaining why he is undertaking many overseas trips early in his term, during a luncheon meeting with Korean compatriots held at a hotel in Paris. Although the comments came in the context of explaining his summit diplomacy schedule, this marks the first time the President has directly addressed the issue of his term since late July, when debate over "constitutional amendment for extended presidency" began stirring controversy in political circles. (프랑스를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 9일(현지 시각) “저의 임기는 헌법상 명확하게 제한돼 있다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이날 파리의 한 호텔에서 열린 동포 오찬 간담회에서 임기 초 해외 순방을 많이 다니는 이유를 설명하며 이같이 말했다. 정상 외교 일정을 설명하며 나온 발언이지만, 정치권에서 ‘연임 개헌’이 논란이 되기 시작한 지난 7월 말 이후 이 대통령이 자신의 임기 문제를 직접 언급한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

President Lee said on the day, "I have scheduled many overseas visits early in my term," adding, "There are several reasons. First, summit diplomacy provides good opportunities for trade, investment, economic cooperation, and security cooperation for South Korea, which is called an open trading nation, and it also boosts engagement among compatriots." He continued, "In any case, because my term is clearly limited under the Constitution, we ultimately need to start quickly in order to enjoy those benefits for a long time." (이 대통령은 이날 “제가 취임 초에 해외 방문을 많이 하려고 지금 잡아놓은 상태”라며 “여러 가지 이유가 있는데, 첫째는 정상 외교는 개방형 통상 국가라고 불리는 대한민국에 무역이나 투자나 경제 협력, 안보 협력에 좋은 기회를 제공해 주고, 동포들 사이에서도 활성도가 높아지는 효과들도 있다”고 했다. 이어 “어쨌든 저의 임기는 헌법상 명확하게 제한돼 있기 때문에 결국은 빨리 시작을 해야 그 효과를 오랫동안 누릴 수가 있다”고 했다.)

Observers suggest that the President's use of his opening remarks at the luncheon with compatriots to raise the term issue is aimed at quelling the "constitutional amendment for extended presidency" controversy, which has been cited as one of the causes of his approval rating dropping to the 30 percent range—the lowest since his inauguration. As the People Power Party continued its offensive during the President's visit to France, questioning whether he intended to extend his term through a constitutional amendment, Hong Ik-pyo, the presidential chief of staff for political affairs, had said the previous day, "The President will make his position more clearly known (soon)." (이 대통령이 동포 오찬 간담회 모두 발언을 이용해 임기 문제를 거론한 것은 대통령 지지율이 취임 후 최저치인 30%대를 기록하고 있는 상황에서 지지율 하락의 원인 중 하나로 지목되는 ‘연임 개헌’ 논란을 잠재우기 위한 것이란 해석이 나온다. 이 대통령의 프랑스 방문 중에도 국민의힘이 “개헌으로 임기 연장을 하려는 의도냐”는 공세를 이어가자, 홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 전날 “(조만간) 좀 더 분명하게 대통령께서 의사를 밝히실 것”이라고 했었다.)

However, even regarding the President's remarks on this day, the opposition has responded that he only mentioned the term limit under the current Constitution and that it is hard to see him drawing a clear line on the issue of re-election or consecutive terms enough to extinguish the controversy. (그러나 이 대통령의 이날 발언을 두고도 야당에서는 현행 헌법상의 임기 제한에 대해 언급했을 뿐, 논란의 불씨를 끌 만큼 명확하게 연임·중임 문제에 선을 그었다고 보기는 어렵다는 반응이 나오고 있다.)

◇Lee's Remarks on His Term at Compatriot Meeting... Opposition: "Public Opinion Turned Sour, So It's About Deflecting the Crisis" (◇李, 동포간담회서 임기 관련 발언… 野 “여론 안 좋자 위기 모면용”)

On the 9th, Kim Tae-gyu, the People Power Party's senior deputy floor spokesperson, said of the President's remarks, "'The presidential term is clearly limited under the Constitution' is an obvious statement that every citizen already knows," adding, "With public opinion turning negative regarding the constitutional amendment for extended presidency, it appears he is making a general statement to immediately deflect the crisis." He further stated, "If this is laying the groundwork to attempt a constitutional amendment for extending the administration, we can never accept that." (국민의힘 김태규 원내수석대변인은 9일 이 대통령의 발언에 대해 “‘대통령 임기가 헌법상 명확히 제한돼 있다’는 건 당연한 소리고 국민 누구나 알고 있다”며 “연임 개헌과 관련해 여론이 안 좋으니 당장 위기를 모면하기 위해 원론적인 얘기를 한 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “만약 정권 연장을 위한 개헌을 시도하려는 하나의 밑자락 깔기라면 우리는 절대 수용할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, at the luncheon with compatriots on the same day, President Lee said, "France completely transformed the very social systems of humanity through the monumental historical event of the great revolution," adding, "South Korea is also undergoing tremendous revolutionary change starting from the night of December 3, 2024 (when martial law was declared)." He continued, "France also went through periods of reaction and counter-revolution during its great revolution, with enormous sacrifices," and "Through regrouping and the defection of the moderate center, it actually faced a dark period again due to counter-revolution." (한편, 이 대통령은 이날 동포 간담회에서 “프랑스는 대혁명이라고 하는 엄청난 역사적 사건을 통해 인류의 사회 제도 자체를 통째로 바꿨다”며 “대한민국도 (비상계엄이 있었던) 2024년 12월 3일, 그 밤을 기점으로 엄청난 혁명적 변화를 겪고 있는 중”이라고 했다. 이어 “프랑스도 대혁명이 진행되는 과정에서 반동의 시기, 반혁명의 시기를 겪었고 엄청난 희생이 있었다”며 “역결집, 중도의 이탈, 이런 것을 통해서 사실은 반혁명으로 다시 어두운 시기를 맞았다”고 했다.)

The President went on to say, "When energy is overflowing, restraint is necessary. We must move in the right direction while minimizing pain and resistance with broad consensus." This is interpreted as signaling to hard-line supporters within the ruling bloc that reform should be approached cautiously to prevent the moderate center from drifting away. In recent days, some within the broader ruling camp have criticized moves such as the President nominating former prosecutor Kim Ji-yong as the candidate to head the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the government partially revising its real estate tax reform plan as a "retreat from reform." <<>> (그러면서 이 대통령은 “에너지가 넘칠 때는 절제할 필요가 있다. 많은 사람의 동의 하에 고통과 저항을 최소화하면서 바람직한 방향으로 나아가야 한다”고 말했다. 이는 여권 강성 지지층을 향해 중도층이 이탈하지 않도록 신중하게 개혁에 접근해야 한다는 생각을 나타낸 것으로 풀이된다. 최근 범여권 일각에서는 이 대통령이 중대범죄수사청 후보자로 검찰 출신 김지용 변호사를 지명하고, 정부가 부동산 세제 개편안을 일부 수정한 것 등에 대해 ‘개혁 후퇴’란 비판이 나오고 있다.)

item.title: Cabinet nominees become 'bad one-homeowners' as non-residents and maxed-out loans... self-inflicted trap for Lee's government (비거주·영끌 ‘나쁜 1주택자’ 된 장관 후보들… 李정부의 자승자박)
item.description:
Of the six minister nominees for the second Lee Jae-myung administration cabinet, five were found to have grown their assets through real estate investments, either by themselves or their families, including holding a "non-resident single home" or "maxed-out borrowing for property speculation." Although some of these occurred over a decade ago, the government has been tightening real estate regulations, such as reducing loans and raising taxes, on the basis that "long-term holding of a non-resident single home is speculation," which is expected to spark controversy during personnel confirmation hearings. The opposition said, "This is the current government's self-inflicted trap for touching public sentiment on real estate." <<> ◇Kang Shin-cheol, suspicion of real estate speculation through fraudulent address registration <<> Regarding Kang Shin-cheol, the nominee for Minister of National Defense, who faced suspicions of obtaining special allocation for an apartment in Seocho-gu, Seoul, by fraudulently registering his address to qualify as a displaced resident, new allegations emerged on the 9th that his father also received a special allocation through the same method. Kang also sparked controversy over the fact that, one year after his son got a job, he borrowed approximately 700 million won from his aunt and uncle to purchase a commercial property in Yangji Village, Bundang, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. <<> In March 2008, while serving in Hwacheon, Gangwon Province, Kang registered his residence at a house in Cheonwang-dong, Guro-gu, Seoul. However, according to personnel confirmation documents obtained by this newspaper on the same day, Kang's father, Kang Mo (83), also registered his residence at a house in Cheonwang-dong near Kang's property in March 2008. The father had been operating a tangerine farm in Seogwipo, Jeju, since the late 1980s, and as of April this year, owns approximately 15,000 square meters of orchard land solely in Seogwipo, Jeju. Yet, he moved his address to his own house in Seoul during that period. <<> The residential lots in the Cheonwang-dong area where Kang and his father registered their addresses were designated in October of that year as the site for the Seoul Southern Detention Center. As the Guro-gu Office compensated and purchased their homes, both Kang and his father each acquired "displaced resident" status and received special allocations for one apartment each in Seocho-gu, Seoul. <<> Regarding the "fraudulent address registration" controversy involving both his father and himself, Kang's side stated on the day, "We understand that the special supply subscription was conducted normally according to procedures." They claim it was not illegal. However, voices in the real estate industry say, "Unlike redevelopment, special supply for displaced residents requires not only ownership but also actual residence," and "If they registered their address to qualify for special supply, isn't that speculation?" <<> ◇From non-resident single homes to maxed-out loans right before lending regulations <<> Two of the six minister nominees are non-resident single homeowners, a category that the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party of Korea have viewed as "effectively speculative gap investments." According to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Choi Su-jin, Lee So-young, nominee for Minister of SMEs and Startups, purchased an apartment in Hongje-dong, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul (84㎡) for 490 million won in February 2016 and lived there for only the first four years. While Lee has been living on a lease in Uiwang-si, Gyeonggi Province—her parliamentary constituency—since February 2020, the actual transaction price of this apartment has risen to around 1 billion won. <<> According to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Sang-hoon, Lee Hyung-il, nominee for Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Minister of Economy and Finance, also purchased an apartment in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province, in February 2009 for 420 million won and has held it for the past 17 years, but actually resided there for only a total of four months across two periods. Questions are being raised as to whether it was effectively for investment rather than residential purposes. This apartment is currently undergoing redevelopment. Lee, who served as First Vice Minister of Economy and Finance in this administration, said last month while announcing the real estate tax reform plan, "We will normalize taxation on non-resident homes and multiple homes to enhance equity." <<> Hong Ji-seon, nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport, faces suspicion of buying a home with a "maxed-out loan" just before lending regulations were tightened under the June 27 real estate measures last year. Hong purchased an apartment in Sindorim, Guro-gu, Seoul, in May last year for 1.005 billion won, covering 367 million won of it with a mortgage loan in his own name and borrowing 170 million won from his mother-in-law, Kim Mo. Around that time, a mortgage of the same amount was registered on an apartment owned by Kim in Suwon-si, Gyeonggi Province. It is presumed that Kim took out a loan using her home as collateral to lend money so that Hong and his spouse could purchase the house. <<> Earlier, Yong Hye-in, nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, also sparked controversy over "short-term flipping" as it was revealed that she bought a house in Ansan, Gyeonggi Province, in April 2021 and resold it in March 2022, earning a capital gain of 20 million won. (이재명 정부 2기 내각 장관 후보자 6명 가운데 5명은 본인이나 가족이 ‘비거주 1주택’, ‘영끌 빚투’ 등 부동산 투자로 자산을 불린 것으로 나타났다. 일부는 10여 년 전 일이지만 정부가 “비거주 1주택 장기 보유는 투기”라며 대출 축소, 세금 인상 등 부동산 규제를 강화하고 있어 인사 청문 과정에서 논란이 될 전망이다. 야당은 “부동산 민심을 건드린 현 정부의 자승자박”이라고 했다.)
